title: Is It Fixable?
lines: Tom's bike had a bent chain.
"Is it fixable?" he said to Dad.
Dad took a look. "The chain is, yes."
"But this seat is not fixable at all."
They went to the shop for a washable seat.
Dad fixed the chain while Tom held the seat.
"You are so likable, Dad," said Tom.

questions.ask: What part of the bike was not fixable?
questions.listenFor: The seat. Line four says it straight out - let them read it again.

questions.ask: Why was the new seat a good pick?
questions.listenFor: It was washable, so it can be washed. Point at the -able ending doing that job.

questions.ask: What is something of yours you would want to be fixable? Why?
questions.listenFor: A toy, a shoe, a book. The why is the part worth waiting for.
